# Inside Triangle

Inside Triangle
Input file: standard input
Output file: standard output
Time limit: 3 seconds
Memory limit: 1024 megabytes
A polygon P1 contains polygon P2 if every point in or on P2 is also in or on P1. A polygon P1 strictly
contains P2 if every point in or on P2 is strictly inside P1 (no point on the boundary).
Panda has two convex polygons, P and Q. Polygon P has n vertices, and polygon Q has m vertices. It is
guaranteed that Q is strictly contained by P.
You should help Panda find the total number of ways to choose exactly 3 distinct vertices from polygon
P that form a triangle P∆ such that P∆ (not strictly) contains polygon Q.
Input
The first line contains a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 1000), denoting the number of test cases.
For each test case, the first line contains an integer n (3 ≤ n ≤ 3 · 105
), denoting the number of vertices
of P.
For the next n lines, each line contains two integers x, y (|x|, |y| ≤ 109
), denoting the coordinates of the
vertices of P. It is guaranteed that the vertices are given in counter-clockwise order, and no three vertices
are collinear.
The next line contains an integer m (3 ≤ m ≤ 3 · 105
), denoting the number of vertices of Q.
For the next m lines, each line contains two integers x, y (|x|, |y| ≤ 109
), denoting the coordinates of the
vertices of Q. It is guaranteed that the vertices are given in counter-clockwise order, and no three vertices
are collinear, and Q is strictly contained by P.
It is guaranteed that both Pn and Pm over all test cases do not exceed 5 · 105
.
Output
For each test case, output an integer in a single line, denoting the answer.

# Inside Triangle

Time limit: $3$ seconds. Memory limit: $1024$ MB. Standard input and standard output.

A polygon $P_1$ contains polygon $P_2$ if every point inside or on $P_2$ is also inside or on $P_1$. It strictly contains $P_2$ if every point inside or on $P_2$ is strictly inside $P_1$, with none on the boundary.

Panda has two convex polygons $P$ and $Q$, with $n$ and $m$ vertices respectively. Polygon $Q$ is strictly contained in $P$.

Count the ways to choose exactly $3$ distinct vertices of $P$ that form a triangle $P_\Delta$ containing $Q$. This containment need not be strict.

![diagram](inside-triangle-diagram.png)

## Input

The first line contains the number of test cases $T$ ($1\leq T\leq1000$).

For each test case, the first line contains $n$ ($3\leq n\leq3\cdot10^5$), the number of vertices of $P$.

The next $n$ lines each contain two integers $x,y$ ($|x|,|y|\leq10^9$), a vertex of $P$. Vertices are listed in counterclockwise order, and no three vertices of this polygon are collinear.

The next line contains $m$ ($3\leq m\leq3\cdot10^5$), the number of vertices of $Q$.

The next $m$ lines each contain two integers $x,y$ ($|x|,|y|\leq10^9$), a vertex of $Q$. Vertices are listed in counterclockwise order, no three vertices of this polygon are collinear, and $Q$ is strictly contained in $P$.

Over all test cases, both $\sum n$ and $\sum m$ do not exceed $5\cdot10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, output the number of valid triangles as one integer on its own line.

## Note

In the first example, polygon $P$ is `ABCDEF` and polygon $Q$ is `GHIJ`. The valid triangles are $\triangle ACE$ and $\triangle BDF$.

translation.markdown:
# Inside Triangle

时间限制：$3$ 秒。内存限制：$1024$ MB。使用标准输入和标准输出。

如果多边形 $P_2$ 内部和边界上的每个点，都位于多边形 $P_1$ 的内部或边界上，则称 $P_1$ 包含 $P_2$。如果多边形 $P_2$ 内部和边界上的每个点，都严格位于 $P_1$ 内部、没有任何点位于其边界上，则称 $P_1$ 严格包含 $P_2$。

Panda 有两个凸多边形 $P$ 和 $Q$，它们分别有 $n$ 和 $m$ 个顶点。保证 $Q$ 被 $P$ 严格包含。

请统计从 $P$ 中恰好选择 $3$ 个不同顶点的方案数，使这些顶点组成的三角形 $P_\Delta$ 包含 $Q$。这里不要求严格包含，允许 $Q$ 的点位于三角形边界上。

![diagram](inside-triangle-diagram.png)

## 输入

第一行包含测试用例数 $T$（$1\leq T\leq1000$）。

每个测试用例的第一行包含整数 $n$（$3\leq n\leq3\cdot10^5$），表示 $P$ 的顶点数。

接下来 $n$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $x,y$（$|x|,|y|\leq10^9$），表示 $P$ 的一个顶点。顶点按逆时针顺序给出，保证该多边形的任意三个顶点不共线。

下一行包含整数 $m$（$3\leq m\leq3\cdot10^5$），表示 $Q$ 的顶点数。

接下来 $m$ 行，每行包含两个整数 $x,y$（$|x|,|y|\leq10^9$），表示 $Q$ 的一个顶点。顶点按逆时针顺序给出，保证该多边形的任意三个顶点不共线，并且 $Q$ 被 $P$ 严格包含。

保证所有测试用例的 $\sum n$ 和 $\sum m$ 都分别不超过 $5\cdot10^5$。

## 输出

对于每个测试用例，在单独一行中输出一个整数，表示满足条件的三角形数量。

## 说明

第一组样例中，多边形 $P$ 为 `ABCDEF`，多边形 $Q$ 为 `GHIJ`。满足条件的三角形是 $\triangle ACE$ 和 $\triangle BDF$。
